name: Further Confusion
blurb: Annual furry convention in San Jose run by the non-profit Anthropomorphic Arts and Education, with panels, dances, dealers and an art show.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'January 14th - 18th, 2027 San Jose Convention Center' and footer '150 W San Carlos St, San Jose, CA 95113 01/14/2027 - 01/18/2027'.

notes: Further Confusion's own homepage has no Guests/Guest-of-Honor nav link or mention; a WebSearch (Wikipedia/WikiFur-sourced) confirms FC has had no designated Guest of Honor program since 2017, so guests is 'none' rather than 'none-yet' -- this con structurally doesn't book a guest lineup. Venue written out as the full 'San Jose McEnery Convention Center' (the same downtown San Jose venue FanimeCon uses); the site's own text just shortens it to 'San Jose Convention Center' at the same 150 W San Carlos St address.
